Item.Name: EQUIP_TYPE
Item.Hint: Enter the equipment type to define QC, or use [LISTVAL].

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
v_local_time date;
v_local_date date;

begin
 
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 v_local_date := v_local_time;
 else
 v_local_date := sysdate;
 end if;
 
 if (:ctrl_blk_1.equip_type is not null) then
 begin
 select substr(mc.code_desc,1,23) into :ctrl_blk_1.s_equipment_desc
 from equip_master_codes mc
 where mc.code_type = 'EQUIP'
 and mc.code = :ctrl_blk_1.equip_type
 and v_local_date between mc.eff_date and nvl(mc.term_date, v_local_date+1);
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error ('3124');
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 else
 show_error ('1307');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
end;

Item.Name: FREQUENCY
Item.Hint: Enter number of periods (i.e., every '2' days), leave blank for variable frequency.

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
v_local_time date;
v_local_date date;

begin
--

if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 v_local_date := v_local_time;
 else
 v_local_date := sysdate;
 end if;
 
-- check to see if this is an integer number greater than zero.
--
 begin
 select (:equip_qc_ctrl_hdr.frequency*1) into :GLOBAL.x
 from dual;
 exception
 when invalid_number then
 :equip_qc_ctrl_hdr.frequency := null;
 show_error ('8020');
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 if (:equip_qc_ctrl_hdr.frequency = '0') then
 :equip_qc_ctrl_hdr.frequency := null;
 show_error ('1321');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if (:equip_qc_ctrl_hdr.frequency < '0') then
 :equip_qc_ctrl_hdr.frequency := null;
 show_error ('1323');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if (:equip_qc_ctrl_hdr.qc_period is not null) then
 if (:equip_qc_ctrl_hdr.qc_period != 'V') then
 begin
 select substr(f.frequency_desc,2,11)||decode(nvl(:equip_qc_ctrl_hdr.frequency,1),1,null,'s')
 into :equip_qc_ctrl_hdr.s_period_desc
 from vequip_qc_frequency f
 where f.frequency_code = :equip_qc_ctrl_hdr.qc_period
 and v_local_date between f.start_date and nvl(f.term_date, v_local_date+1);
 exception
 when others then 
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 else
 :equip_qc_ctrl_hdr.qc_period := null;
 :equip_qc_ctrl_hdr.s_period_desc := null;
 end if;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 execute_trigger ('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 if (:equip_qc_ctrl_hdr.worksheet_flag = 'Y') then
 if (:SYSTEM.block_status = 'CHANGED') then
 execute_trigger ('commit_equip_qc_ctrl_hdr');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
--
-- Populate the detail block, if editing data, otherwise initialize for new record.
--
 :GLOBAL.x := null;
 begin
 select 'X' into :GLOBAL.x
 from equip_qc_ctrl qc
 where qc.qc_id = :equip_qc_ctrl_hdr.qc_id;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 go_block ('schedule');
 :schedule.qc_id := :equip_qc_ctrl_hdr.qc_id;
 :schedule.arrange_by :=(:SYSTEM.cursor_record * 100);
 :schedule.ref_number := 1;
 go_block ('schedule');
 go_item ('schedule.qc_item');
 when too_many_rows then
 -- null;
/* Diptiia - 3.1 - SCR 327 - Commented out null and added the code to handle too many rows error as when a too many rows
 error was encountered the form would just leave the control on the wroksheet_flag field and not move to the next block */
 
 go_block ('schedule');
 :schedule.qc_id := :equip_qc_ctrl_hdr.qc_id;
 :schedule.arrange_by :=(:SYSTEM.cursor_record * 100);
 :schedule.ref_number := 1;
 go_block ('schedule');
 go_item ('schedule.qc_item');
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 if (:GLOBAL.x = 'X') then
 go_block ('schedule');
 execute_query;
 GO_ITEM ('schedule.qc_item');
 end if;
 else
 go_item ('review_code');
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: COMMIT_EQUIP_QC_CTRL_HDR
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
v_local_time date;
v_local_date date;

begin
 if (:equip_qc_ctrl_hdr.review_code is null) then
 go_item ('equip_qc_ctrl_hdr.review_code');
 show_error ('0010');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if (:equip_qc_ctrl_hdr.eff_date is null) then
 go_item ('equip_qc_ctrl_hdr.eff_date');
 show_error ('0010');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if (:equip_qc_ctrl_hdr.qc_period is null) then
 go_item ('equip_qc_ctrl_hdr.qc_period');
 show_error ('0010');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if (:equip_qc_ctrl_hdr.required_flag is null) then
 go_item ('equip_qc_ctrl_hdr.required_flag');
 show_error ('0010');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 v_local_date := v_local_time;
 else
 v_local_date := sysdate;
 end if;
 
 if(:equip_qc_ctrl_hdr.qc_id is null) then
 begin
 select 'ID-'||substr(to_char(to_number(nvl(max(substr(qc_id,4)),0))+1,'099999'),2,6)
 into :equip_qc_ctrl_hdr.qc_id
 from equip_qc_ctrl_hdr;
 exception 
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 :equip_qc_ctrl_hdr.last_modified_date := v_local_date;
 :equip_qc_ctrl_hdr.modified_by := :banner.user_id;
--
 :SYSTEM.message_level := 25;
 commit;
 :SYSTEM.message_level := 0;
 show_error ('0000');
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: SCHEDULE_SEQUENCE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure schedule_sequence is
begin
 :global.current_record := :system.cursor_record;
 :global.current_field := :system.cursor_field;
 :global.max_ref := 0;
 go_record ('1');
 while (:schedule.qc_id is not null ) loop
 if (nvl(:schedule.arrange_by,0) != (:system.cursor_record*100)) then
 :schedule.arrange_by := (:system.cursor_record * 100);
 end if;
 if (:schedule.ref_number >= :global.max_ref) then
 :global.max_ref := :schedule.ref_number+1;
 end if;
 next_record;
 end loop;
 go_record (:global.current_record);
 if (:schedule.ref_number is null) then
 :schedule.ref_number := :global.max_ref;
 end if;
 GO_ITEM (:global.current_field);
end;
